Linking needs the special linker and link-args used by build.py. Let me use the same options as build.py: `-C link-arg=--threads=2 -C linker=/opt/rust/lib/rustlib/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/bin/rust-lld` and index the rlib (rustc may warn that the rlib was built for a different crate; should be ok since same target musl).

Let me redo the compile with those flags. Also note the .o files leaked into /workspace/dev — use a TMPDIR.

arguments.command: cd /workspace/dev && rm -f *.rcgu.o dump && mkdir -p /workspace/dev/tmp && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/rust/lib TMPDIR=/workspace/dev/tmp /opt/rust/bin/rustc --edition=2021 --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl -C opt-level=2 -C codegen-units=1 -A warnings -C link-arg=--threads=2 -C linker=/opt/rust/lib/rustlib/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/bin/rust-lld --crate-name dump dump.rs --extern rust_unit_merge=/workspace/tmp/unit-merge-build/librust_unit_merge.rlib -o /workspace/dev/dump 2>&1 | tail -5; ls -la /workspace/dev/dump && ./dump 1 3 2 0 0 0 0 0 0 | head -8
